name: barbell-concentration-curl.html
instructions:
1. Grab a flat bench and sit the barbell you want to use at one end (you can also use an EZ bar).
2. Sit on the end of the bench with your feet slightly wider than should width apart.
3. Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip (palms facing up), with your hands about 6-8 inches apart.
4. Lean forward until your upper arms are touching the inside of your thighs.
5. Use your thighs to hold your arms in position throughout the exercise.
6. Keeping your head up, eyes facing forward, slowly curl the barbell up as far as possible.
7. Squeeze the biceps and then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
8. Repeat for desired reps.
